text:
The bug is in `src/cachetools/__init__.py`, `Cache.__setitem__`. For a new key, the eviction loop uses `while self.__currsize + diffsize >= maxsize`, which evicts an existing item even when the new item would bring the cache exactly to `maxsize`. This affects all subclasses because they delegate insertion to this shared method.

I intend to change that new-key boundary from `>=` to `>`, preserving the existing replacement logic and allowing entries whose total size equals `maxsize`.
